findings.title: A key for the payments service is written in the code
findings.problem: The key the program uses to take payments is written into payments.js.
findings.whyItMatters: Anyone who can read the code can take payments as you.
findings.fixedLooksLike: The key is not in the code, and the code reads it from somewhere private instead.
findings.outsideStep: Change the key at the payments provider: only a person can do that.

findings.title: Checks of secure connections are turned off
findings.problem: The program does not check it is talking to the real server.
findings.whyItMatters: Someone on the same network could read or change what is sent.
